references.text: The Passover lamb was to be eaten with unleavened bread and bitter herbs, the same elements mentioned in Joshua 5:11
The command to eat unleavened bread during the Passover festival, which the Israelites now celebrate for the first time in the Promised Land
The command regarding the Feast of Unleavened Bread and that they should eat unleavened bread for seven days
The prohibition against eating from the land's harvest before the firstfruits offering was brought
The rules for the firstfruits offering and that they were not to eat from the new crop until the offering had been given
The command to eat unleavened bread for seven days during the Passover festival
The Israelites kept the Passover on the plains of Gilgal on the fourteenth day of the month, the same event that verse 11 describes as following the meal
The day after they ate from the land's harvest, the manna ceased—a direct continuation of verse 11
